description: Kafka (DMS) Performance Monitoring Dashboard using CloudEye (SberCloud) metrics. This dashboard provides comprehensive monitoring for Kafka DMS instances with full observability coverage matching CloudEye. KEY SECTIONS: - Cluster Status: Broker status, partitions, replication health - Broker Resources: CPU usage, memory usage, disk usage, heap usage - Network & Throughput: Bytes in/out rate, messages in rate, network bandwidth usage - Producer/Consumer Metrics: Produce/fetch latency, messages consumed, messages remained - Disk I/O: Disk read/write rate, disk read/write await, disk usage - Topic & Partition Metrics: Topic data size, partition messages, current topics/partitions DATA SOURCE: Metrics are collected via prometheus-cloudeye-exporter from SberCloud CloudEye service.

panels.description: Total consumer lag (excluding estate-web-ws-* WebSocket session groups): sum of messages not yet consumed for the remaining groups and topics. Zero = healthy; rising = consumers falling behind. For per-group and per-topic lag including estate-web-ws-*, see panels Consumer Lag by Group and Consumer Lag by Topic.
